caption: The drawing consists of a repeating pattern made up of large, rainbow-like arches and six-petaled flower shapes. The arches are arranged in rows, with each arch consisting of five colored bands in the order from outside to inside: blue, brown, yellow, light brown, and green. The arches touch each other at their peaks horizontally. Between the arches in the upper row, there are three yellow flowers with brown centers. At the bottom of the drawing, there is a row of brown triangular shapes resembling stylized mountains or hills. The background is a solid off-white or beige color. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there are four rectangular color swatches in vertical alignment: blue, brown, green, and off-white, with handwritten text reading, "This project is to be painted using above American colors." At the bottom right corner, the words "Espanola, House, [illegible] N. M." are written in small letters. The composition is symmetrical and extends to the edges, with most elements evenly distributed.
title: Colcha
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
